purpose: Identify official USGS Landsat-9 post-event scene candidates for the ESA 26 August versus 24 August visual comparison without reading image or QA pixels.
geometry_method: Shapely 2.1.2 STAC and approved-AOI polygon intersection in EPSG:4326; fractions are angular-area screens, not geodesic or usable-pixel coverage.

pre_event_catalog_screen.note: The 10/26 August Landsat-9 pair is a possible same-sensor route. Catalog transforms lie on the same 30 m lattice, but scene-level cloud statistics still require pixel QA and true residual registration remains unmeasured. A new source decision is required before use.

checked_against: Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC exact items
same_sensor_pair_catalog_grid_relation.implication: A shared overlap window can be selected on catalog coordinates without interpolating either date solely to align grid origins, if exact acquired COG headers verify these transforms. Residual image-to-image geolocation still requires independent measurement before any difference or change claim.

candidate_host_neutral_asset_set.note: Both exact USGS STAC items list all seven roles. The initial QA-only stage can screen flags but cannot establish final display-band valid fraction or reflectance without reading the three display bands; any QA-only pass is preliminary.

official_usgs_known_issue_relevant_to_ao.summary: USGS documents Landsat 8-9 Collection 2 surface-reflectance aerosol overcorrection near bright snow/ice and cloud, possible reflectance outside 0..1, and band NoData near cloud edges that QA_PIXEL may not flag. It recommends examining SR_QA_AEROSOL validity and aerosol-level bits.
official_usgs_known_issue_relevant_to_ao.implication: Future pixel QA must measure per-band nodata and out-of-range values independently of QA_PIXEL, retain aerosol QA strata, and keep bright snow/ice uncertainty visible. No exact-scene incidence is claimed.

usgs_asset_head.result: All six nominal USGS GeoTIFF URLs redirected to an ERS login HTML page; final HTTP 200 and 33171-byte text/html describe the login page, not asset availability.

usgs_aws_option.note: The USGS-hosted AWS bucket is requester pays. No charged AWS route is authorized or tested.

planetary_computer_metadata_option.note: Microsoft documents anonymous STAC and no-account SAS issuance with rate limits. The rendered supplemental terms say accessing or attempting to use the preview constitutes acceptance, so no further Microsoft-host request is proposed without an exact owner decision. No SAS token was requested, stored, displayed, or used.

planetary_computer_terms_page_read_only_.rendered_heading: Supplemental Terms of Use for Microsoft Planetary Computer Previews
material_conditions_observed: The page says access to or attempted use of the Previews accepts its Supplemental Terms and ratifies acceptance of the linked Microsoft Terms of Use.
It describes Previews as for evaluation and testing, not mission-critical use, and provided as-is with limited remedies.
It says data-access tokens are individual, time-limited, confidential, non-transferable except within stated personnel/contractor conditions, and subject to rate limits.
planetary_computer_terms_page_read_only_.next_boundary: No further Microsoft catalog, token, or data request pending an exact owner decision about this host and its terms.

cross_sensor_before_context.note: ESA's composed image does not override this exact local before-scene pixel screen or authorize reuse.

limits: Scene-wide cloud cover does not establish usable pixels in an approved AOI.
Footprint coverage does not establish clear or registered pixels.
No raster, QA, thumbnail, MTL, or other asset bytes were requested; six USGS asset HEAD requests followed login redirects only.
A Landsat/Sentinel-2 comparison requires separately reviewed cross-sensor spectral, resolution, and registration methods.
No source substitution, acquisition, processing, map inclusion, change analysis, attribution, or publication is approved by this observation.
disposition: metadata_candidates_only; the existing 24 August Sentinel-2 failure blocks promoting the ESA-style pair under current criteria, while the 10/26 August same-sensor Landsat-9 alternative remains unassessed at pixel level and its asset access path unapproved
